_meta.description: forecast-slip-reason (REQ-FRC-012): a commit or best-case deal whose expected close date moves past the end of its fiscal period says why. ForecastDealService refuses the slip without a reason; DealUpdatedListener stamps where the close date slipped from and when. A late fragment so the lead version moves past the other lead fragments.

slip_reason.title: Slip reason
slip_reason.description: Why the expected close date moved past the end of the forecast period. Required when a commit or best-case deal slips.

slipped_from.title: Slipped from
slipped_from.description: The expected close date before the deal last slipped.

slipped_at.title: Slipped at
slipped_at.description: When the deal last slipped out of its forecast period.
